description: This file contains unit tests for the NoteUtil class in the Android project, specifically testing text processing functions such as checking for empty lines, extracting lines without markdown, generating note titles and excerpts, and handling markdown stripping. It uses JUnit and Robolectric for testing Android-specific code.

classes.name: NoteUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for the NoteUtil utility functions, verifying behavior of text processing methods in various scenarios.

methods.name: testIsEmptyLine
methods.description: Tests the NoteUtil.isEmptyLine method with various whitespace and newline inputs.

methods.name: testGetLineWithoutMarkdown
methods.description: Tests extraction of lines without markdown syntax from different input strings.

methods.name: testGenerateNoteTitle
methods.description: Verifies the correct generation of note titles from various input strings, including handling of markdown and specific issues.

methods.name: testGenerateNoteExcerpt
methods.description: Tests the generation of note excerpts from content and title, including handling of markdown, empty lines, and edge cases.

methods.name: testGenerateNoteExcerpt_sdk_30
methods.description: Specific test for note excerpt generation on SDK 30, addressing known issues with HtmlCompat.fromHtml.
